case_title: Defective Laptop and Disputed Product Damage

additional_evidence_concerns.concern: The report does not conclusively establish the cause of the damage.

expected_defects.description: The claimant cites Section 99-B of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. This is a deliberately planted citation that must be checked against the local legal corpus.
The claimant assumes overheating automatically proves a manufacturing defect.
The respondents suggest improper usage without conclusive supporting proof.

citation_verdicts.citation_text: Section 99-B of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019
citation_verdicts.reason: The citation is deliberately planted and must not be accepted without verification against the local legal corpus.

expected_outcome.status: Further Legal and Factual Review Required
expected_outcome.recommended_action: Verify the legal citation and examine the technical evidence and both parties' claims.

The Section 99-B citation must be flagged for verification.
